privacy_note: All dates are public historical event dates or boundary values (docs/product-brief.md section 12, CLAUDE.md section 7.6). None is anyone's birthday.

cell_fields.expect: present = at least the must_appear / must_appear_one_of item | none = the source is called but nothing matching exists | no_request = the source must not be called at all (reason says why) | not_researched = research has no data for this cell
cell_fields.must_not_appear: wrong videos the research saw (wrong day, wrong stage of the event, retrospective, unrelated)
cell_fields.found_but_not_allowlisted: research found a match on a channel outside the allowlist; it must not appear while the allowlist is KTV Archive only
cell_fields.evidence: research evidence numbers, resolved in the top-level evidence object (url null = no public URL)
cell_fields.evidence_gap: what the research did not observe directly

global_rules: A video whose capture time is unknown is shown as unknown ('촬영 시점 미상'); the event date is never written into captured_at (CLAUDE.md 7.1).
A Commons DateTimeOriginal later than the event date is an upload or restoration date: captured_at must be null (research R-V3).
A 'today' retrospective edit (KTV 'YYYY-MM-DD 오늘' clips) may match the date but its captured_at must be null (research R-Y3).
Daehan News matches are labeled approx: the issue date comes from the index and is not the filming day (research R-N3).
tragic events: no video and no search request, including the date-level Commons date category (research R-V9, docs/product-brief.md 6.3).
A date with no event: no Wikidata, Commons, YouTube or index request.
Media files are never downloaded; only URLs are recorded.
